brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain error. All six RC items are met with appropriate red-flag screening, medication safety counseling, pending-results tracking, executable handoff plan, and caregiver receipt via teach-back. Two high-order points (HO3: responsibility-chain repair, HO4: safe bounded closure) are completed with meaningful impact. Dimensions are good or excellent across the board. Closure is valid, safe, executable, and traceable. Grade 5 is warranted.
